title: Browser Autonomy Benchmark Suite
description: Thirty-three underspecified single-HTML browser tasks. Prompt A is the frozen v1 minimum statement. B and C remain reserved ladder slots until those prompts are written.

A.name: Raw
A.purpose: Minimum specification. Measures natural interpretation and unsolicited quality decisions.

B.name: Autonomous
B.purpose: Same task with explicit permission to make design and implementation decisions. Prompt text is reserved.

C.name: Showcase
C.purpose: Same task as a self-running, visually polished showcase. Prompt text is reserved.

benchmarks.title: Rollercoaster

prompts.A: Create a first-person rollercoaster with continuous playback in a single HTML file using Three.js.

benchmarks.notes: Do not add hidden implementation requirements beyond the prompt. Evaluate what the model chooses to contribute.
